C0.quote: is to develop a method of detecting gerrymandering
C0.note: The paper proposes a statistical, nonparametric learning method to detect anomalies (gerrymandering or electoral bias) in observed FPTP election results, and tests it on simulated and real data. It does not study a voting rule's inputs, strategic behaviour, or computation. It is therefore treated as statistical analysis of election outcomes rather than the study of a voting procedure.
